from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the document")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial line item (e.g., '交易性金融资产')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the financial item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem]
